name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche to appear for confirmation hearing, U.S. restarts blockade against Iran amid standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, ICE suspends traffic stops after deadly shootings.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The parasite, which has sickened thousands across the U.S., is notoriously difficult to track. Funding cuts haven’t made the job easier.

changes.title: How to protect yourself from the diarrhea-causing parasite as cyclosporiasis cases rise
changes.summary: Federal and state health officials are looking for the source of a cyclosporiasis outbreak as cases rise in the U.S. Carter Evans has more information on the spread of the cyclospora parasite.

changes.title: Watch Live: Jay Clayton, Trump
changes.summary: Clayton, currently the U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York, is expected to succeed Bill Pulte, Trump.

changes.title: Wildfires expose millions in Midwest, Northeast to dangerous smoke
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is expected to engulf large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week.

changes.title: US Resumes Hormuz Blockade as Trump Threatens More Strikes
changes.summary: The United States is escalating its attacks on Iran, striking military targets including coastal defense systems and missile and drone sites. It comes as President Donald Trump in an interview warned that the U.S. will begin striking civilian infrastructure including energy targets unless Iran agrees to negotiate. NBC’.

changes.title: Trump Flip-Flops on Strait of Hormuz Plan, and U.S. Cyclospora Outbreak Spreads
changes.summary: Plus, Chipotle is coming to Mexico.

changes.title: U.S. reimposes blockade and steps up strikes as Iran threatens to halt all energy exports from the region
changes.summary: Iranian officials said Wednesday that the American strikes hit an Iranian army barracks, killed at least seven troops and wounded more than 260 people across the country.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Indian business magnate Gautam Adani said his pledge to invest billions of dollars in the U.S. did not influence the Justice Department’s decision to move to drop the criminal case against him.
